thread:
Jamie H: kicking off nyc2 GPU cluster network bring-up. scope: transit peering, NGW NAT, private hosted zone, and egress smoke tests. planning window 04:00-06:00 UTC.
Sara L: looks good. what's the plan for transit attachments? new TGW or reuse central? :thinking_face:
Jamie H: reuse central-tgw via an additional attachment scoped to nyc2-vpc. will tag for billing. I pushed a draft terraform change in infra/nyc2/branch.
Devon K: sgtm. checklist?
Jamie H: short checklist:
- create TGW attachment + accept
- propagate routes to nyc2 route table
- NGW in private subnets for controlled egress
- update outbound route table -> 0.0.0.0/0 -> NGW
- private hosted zone delegation to accounts/dns
- run traceroutes and dig validation
- smoke perf + cost estimate
Mohamed A: pinging netops to pre-approve BGP ranges. they requested ACL for management CIDRs.
Ops-Bot: terraform apply plan: 6 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy (ID: plan-nyc2-2026-03-18)
Sara L: drop the key command you used to accept tg attachment? I forget the exact aws call.
Jamie H: sure:
```
aws ec2 accept-transit-gateway-vpc-attachment --transit-gateway-attachment-id tgw-attach-0abcd1234
```
then confirm propagation:
```
aws ec2 describe-transit-gateway-route-table-entries --transit-gateway-route-table-id tgw-rtb-0abcd
```
Lina P: after attach, add route in TGW route table -> target `tgw-attach-0abcd1234` for the nyc2 CIDR block. also confirm there are no overlapping CIDRs.
Devon K: NAT design: using NGW (NAT Gateway) with autoscaling not required. We'll start with one NGW per AZ and enable automated failover later.
Mohamed A: cost callout: NGW per AZ ~ $0.045/hr + data egress. we should enable prefix-list for common destinations to avoid hairpin.
Jamie H: delegating private hosted zone: create NS record in account-dns zone pointing to nyc2 VPC resolver. steps:
```
aws route53 create-hosted-zone --name nyc2.internal.redwood.ai --vpc VPCRegion=us-east-1,VPCId=vpc-0abc --caller-reference "nyc2-20260318"
```
then share the zone via Resource Access Manager with account infra-dns.
Sara L: validation commands I plan to run during window:
- `dig +short @10.0.0.2 serviceA.nyc2.internal` -> expect 10.2.5.12
- `traceroute -n 8.8.8.8` from a GPU node -> expect first hop -> NGW private ip
- `curl -sS --resolve api.redwood.ai:443:PUBLIC_IP https://api.redwood.ai/health` -> check egress path
Devon K: perf smoke: generate 10 concurrent LLM inference calls (small prompt) for 5 mins via canary route and measure p95 latency and tokens/sec.
Ops-Bot: scheduled window: 2026-03-18T04:00:00Z - 2026-03-18T06:00:00Z
Jamie H: quick diag note if egress fails: check `ip route`, `iptables -t nat -L`, verify NGW eni attachments, and confirm TGW route propagation. common culprit: missing propagation in TGW route table.
Mohamed A: ALLOWED: management CIDRs 203.0.113.0/28 for jumpboxes. Deny everything else until smoke passes.
Lina P: I've created the RBAC ticket for ops and cc'd netops, will update when they accept peering.
Sara L: ready to take handoff once smoke green. @Devon can you own the perf run? @Mohamed can you own access controls?
Devon K: happy to own perf run.
Mohamed A: will approve ACLs and monitor billing alerts for the first 24h.
Jamie H: final note for oncall: fallback plan -> detach TGW attachment and revert route table to previous default route to avoid accidental cross-region blast. keep me on call for 2 hours post-cutover. :thumbsup:
Lina P: 👍 all set, initiating apply at 04:05 UTC.
Ops-Bot: apply complete: 6 resources created. (plan-nyc2-2026-03-18)
Sara L: smoke step results:
- dig looks good: `10.2.5.12`
- traceroute -> shows hop to NGW ENI 10.0.1.1 -> then internet
- perf: p95=180ms, tokens/sec=1200 (baseline similar)
Devon K: perf stable. no errors.
Mohamed A: ACLs enforced. billing alert threshold set to $50/day for nyc2 initial.
Jamie H: handoff: tagging incident channel #nyc2-prod, adding runbook link infra/nyc2/runbook.md and assigning week-of oncall. thanks team.
Lina P: handing to oncall. :white_check_mark:
